clue.text: Girl named as queen, for example

definitions.meaning: Honor or ... is a girl's given name
in card games such as bridge the ace, king, queen, jack and ten of trumps are the top-ranking cards

explanation.surface: A girl is named after a queen, as many are.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, and in bridge a queen is one of the high-ranking honour cards.

clue.text: Early radio broadcast tactless about what links stations

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shuffled letters go around the railway abbreviation
broadcast means scattered, so the letters of the word tactless are spread into a new order

parts.note: a railway links stations; RY is its abbreviation

explanation.surface: An early radio programme was tactless about the network connecting its stations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Early radio broadcast' reads as one phrase, but 'broadcast' is the anagram signal, so the definition is just 'Early radio'.
explanation.definitionFit: A crystal set was a simple early radio receiver using a crystal detector.

clue.text: Conspicuousness of legal right in complicated case

indicators.note: in puts the legal term inside the rearranged letters
complicated means mixed up, so the letters of case are rearranged

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: A lawyer judges how prominent a legal right is in a tangled case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'legal right' is the lien, a debt claim on property; 'complicated' and 'in' are the two signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Salience is the quality of standing out, a synonym for conspicuousness.

clue.text: Normal choice between public and private growth areas

parts.note: a common is a piece of public land open to all
the word or offers a choice between two things
a garden is a private plot where plants are grown

explanation.surface: Picking between a public park and a private plot to grow things is an ordinary choice.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means ordinary or everyday, nothing special.

clue.text: Moving specially on board, put line out and fish

parts.note: an angler casts, putting the fishing line out
ling is a long-bodied sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: An angler puts out a line and catches a fish.
explanation.walkthrough: The angling picture hides a chess move: the king and rook move together in one special turn.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess, castling is the special move of king and rook together on the board.

clue.text: Moderate US college with one way to gain entrance

parts.note: MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology
I is the Roman numeral one
a gate is a way in

explanation.surface: A US college provides one route for getting admitted.
explanation.definitionFit: To mitigate is to make less severe, a synonym for moderate as a verb.

clue.text: See 4
Raised hat covering a face

indicators.note: raised in a down answer means the letters are read upwards, so backwards
covering means the lid goes over and around the letter a

parts.note: a lid is slang for a hat

explanation.surface: A raised hat uncovers someone's face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covering' puts A inside LID to make LAID, and 'Raised' turns that upwards into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A dial is the face of a clock or watch with its markings.

clue.text: Mark school put up

indicators.note: put up in a down answer means the letters are read from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: A school put up a mark for its pupils.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' turns ETON round in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: A note is a mark or sign, as in a written note or a mark of distinction.

clue.text: It has its place in TV humour

definitions.text: It has its place in TV humour

parts.words: It has its place in TV humour
parts.note: a comedy series set around a fixed situation, often one place such as a flat or office

explanation.surface: Every piece of television comedy has its own setting.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation comedy is TV humour built around one recurring place and set of characters.

clue.text: Partisan letters misrepresented candidate

indicators.note: the letters of the word partisan are misrepresented, set down in a different order

explanation.surface: Biased letters gave a false picture of an election candidate.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspirant is someone seeking a post or honour, a synonym for candidate.

clue.text: Deceptive skill shown in composition of endless German lieder

indicators.note: a composition is something put together, so these letters are arranged afresh
endless means the final letter of lieder is dropped

explanation.surface: A conjuror's trick lies in setting endless German songs to music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts LIEDER to LIEDE, and 'composition of' rearranges GERMAN + LIEDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Legerdemain is sleight of hand, trickery that deceives by skill.

clue.text: Fight as mature soldiers in English outfit, ultimately

indicators.note: in places the age-and-soldiers pair inside the other letters
ultimately points to the last letter of outfit

parts.note: to mature is to age
men is a common term for soldiers, especially the ranks

explanation.surface: Grown-up soldiers fight in an English regiment in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fight' as a verb pulls toward the wrong answer; it is the noun, a military clash, with 'as' joining it to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An engagement is a battle or military clash, a synonym for a fight.

clue.text: As a rule, no woman's capable of doing it

definitions.text: As a rule, no woman's capable of doing it

parts.words: As a rule, no woman's capable of doing it
parts.note: read as a sexist claim, but 'rule' is reigning: only a man can hold a monarch's male title

explanation.surface: A bigot claims that women generally cannot do a certain job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As a rule' looks like 'generally', but it means 'as a ruler': the office held by a male monarch is by definition not a woman's.
explanation.definitionFit: The office of a male sovereign is one that, by its title, no woman can hold.

clue.text: Girl from city of David

definitions.meaning: Michelangelo's statue David stands in this Italian city, Tuscany's capital

explanation.surface: A girl comes from the biblical city of King David.
explanation.walkthrough: 'city of David' suggests Jerusalem or Bethlehem; the David here is Michelangelo's statue.
explanation.definitionFit: A common girl's name and the Tuscan city that houses Michelangelo's David.

clue.text: One of those sweet utterances of lovers in love

definitions.text: One of those sweet utterances of lovers
definitions.meaning: sweet ... are the soft words lovers murmur
in tennis scoring love means zero

explanation.surface: Lovers murmur sweet words to each other when in love.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweet nothings are lovers' endearments, and love in tennis means a score of zero.

clue.text: I hold forth about king — it becomes a nuisance

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the ranting word goes around the king and it

parts.note: to rant is to hold forth loudly
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Someone sounding off about the king becomes an annoyance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it becomes' looks like the link, but 'it' is fodder; only 'becomes' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An irritant is something that annoys, a synonym for nuisance.

clue.text: Better than the usual places I converted

indicators.note: converted means changed into another form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Places I turned into something are better than ordinary.
explanation.definitionFit: Special means exceptional, above the ordinary, so better than the usual.

clue.text: Conservative taking position close to supporters

definitions.meaning: a winger on the right flank plays near the touchline, close to the watching fans

explanation.surface: A Tory politician takes a stance close to the party faithful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporters' reads as party members, but they are football fans by the touchline.
explanation.definitionFit: A right-winger is a political conservative and also a player on the right wing of a team.

clue.text: With anger cut short, aimed at peace

parts.note: ire is anger

indicators.note: short means the last letter of the word for cut is lost

parts.note: a nick is a small cut

explanation.surface: With temper curbed, someone pursues peace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims NICK to NIC; 'cut' is a noun here, not 'reduced'.
explanation.definitionFit: Irenic means peaceable or conciliatory, from the Greek for peace.

clue.text: Hostile takeover company mounted

parts.note: a rider who has mounted is up, on the horse

explanation.surface: A company launches a hostile bid.
explanation.definitionFit: A coup is a sudden seizure of power, a hostile takeover of government.

clue.text: Salty cheese with fine Greek character

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A salty cheese suits a fine Greek person.
explanation.definitionFit: Feta is the salty white Greek cheese made from sheep's or goat's milk.

clue.text: Labour too long in office and someone must pay for it?

definitions.text: Labour too long in office and someone must pay for it?

parts.words: Labour too long in office and someone must pay for it?
parts.note: reads as a party outstaying its term, but is extra work beyond normal hours in the office, which the employer pays

explanation.surface: A Labour government stays in power too long and somebody has to foot the bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' with a capital looks like the British political party, but it is plain work.
explanation.definitionFit: Hours worked beyond the normal working day, typically paid at a premium rate.

clue.text: Female bird with a male in enclosure

indicators.note: in puts the article and the male pronoun inside the enclosure

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals
he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: A hen bird lives with a male in a pen.
explanation.definitionFit: A peahen is the female of the peafowl.

clue.text: Twice as straightforward?

parts.note: the phrase joins two words that each mean straightforward, so it is doubly so

explanation.surface: Something is asked to be made doubly easy.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means utterly straightforward, built from two synonyms for uncomplicated.

clue.text: See 24
